notes.title: Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [p]Hello and thank you for your interest in our demo. [/p][p][/p][p]We are happy to join our very first Steam Next Fest! We look forward to hear what you think of our demo, and we will strive to respond to as many of you as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]We will be updating the demo continously as we receive your feedback and thoughts throughout this Steam Next Fest. Right now we are aware of several issues with the demo, but we are working hard to resolve them and we will be updating as soon as possible. The intended version of our demo is delayed by a couple of hours.[/p][p]The Steam servers seem very busy at the moment, so updates will be slow initially because of this bottleneck.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We hope you enjoy our demo![/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]Best regards[/i][/p][p][i]Team Mayorham[/i][/p]
